title: Lumina Cover
contextTitle: Lumina: Intelligent Stargazing Personalized for You
context: Lumina is a data-driven mobile application designed to optimize stargazing experiences through intelligent environmental analysis. By combining real-time weather data, moon phase tracking, light pollution (Bortle scale), and celestial event forecasting, Lumina delivers personalized recommendations for the best times and locations to observe the night sky. Built for both beginners and experienced astronomers, Lumina transforms complex astronomical and environmental data into actionable insights.
techStack: Lumina is built using React Native with NativeWind for a responsive and modern mobile UI. Authentication is handled via Auth0. The backend is powered by Express.js and deployed on AWS ECS with Fargate for scalable containerized services. Data is stored in AWS DynamoDB, enabling efficient retrieval of user preferences, environmental data, and recommendation outputs.
solutionOverview: Lumina aggregates and analyzes multiple data sources—weather conditions, lunar cycles, light pollution metrics, and astronomical events—to generate personalized stargazing recommendations. Core features include real-time weather and moon phase displays, a dynamic celestial event calendar, and intelligent suggestions for nearby optimal viewing locations based on environmental conditions.
solutionImpact: Lumina simplifies a traditionally complex decision-making process by automating multi-factor analysis into a single, user-friendly interface. Users can quickly identify high-quality stargazing opportunities without needing domain expertise, significantly reducing planning time and increasing successful observation experiences.
designOutcome: The application emphasizes clarity and immersion through a clean, minimal interface inspired by the night sky. Dark-themed visuals reduce eye strain in low-light environments, while intuitive navigation and structured data presentation allow users to quickly access critical information such as visibility conditions and upcoming celestial events.
